title: Tapping Into Beauty’s Everyday Fanbase
summary: Spotify's Ann Piper shared insights into how the music giant continues to tap into various fandoms and is helping brands expand their reach.

extraction.key_fact: Spotify가 다양한 팬덤을 활용해 뷰티 브랜드의 도달 범위를 넓히는 방법을 소개했다.
